# Patched go-imap v1.2.1 (SR3-mail-k18)

Upstream github.com/emersion/go-imap v1.2.1 (go.sum h1:+s9ZjMEjOB8NzZMVTM3cCenz2JrQIGGo5j1df19WjTA=), the packages broker imports, without tests; LICENSE is upstream's. broker/go.mod replaces the module with this directory. One edit, in client/client.go, marked `agentos:`: `reader` recovers a panic, closes the connection and ends (the in-flight command then fails with errClosed). It covers panics only, not a stack overflow or memory exhaustion from a hostile reply (#1254) or a panic while `c.locker` is held (#1255). date.go differs only by gofmt's comment reflow (CI's Format step). No response handler is edited. See broker/mail/ASSUMPTIONS.md for when to drop this.
